access: Symbol background at the entry level

preparation.label: Print and select an appropriate grid level
preparation.materials: Paper and pencil or optional laminate and marker

teaching_steps.title: Preview
teaching_steps.detail: Read the six words and identify their pictures.

teaching_steps.title: Search
teaching_steps.detail: Scan across and down, adding diagonals at later levels.

teaching_steps.title: Check
teaching_steps.detail: Compare completed grids with the answer key.

scarborough.statement: Reinforces recognition of familiar letter sequences and book-linked vocabulary.
